source: Affordable Care Act marketplace subsidy mechanics: the federal poverty level (HHS 2025 guidelines, which govern 2026 coverage), the applicable-percentage table, and the 400%-of-FPL eligibility ceiling that returns for 2026 with the expiry of the 2021–2025 enhanced subsidies unless Congress extends them.
confidenceNote: The FPL figures and the applicable percentages are transcribed from memory and NOT checked against the HHS notice or the IRS revenue procedure; whether the 400% cliff applies in 2026 depends on legislation that may have moved. Shown as a warning, never as a dollar figure of subsidy.
note: MAGI above cliffMultiple × FPL for the household size loses the premium tax credit entirely (the 'cliff'). Below it, the expected contribution is applicablePercentage × MAGI. engines/tax.js only flags the cliff and the distance to it; it does not price a plan. D-064.

fpl.note: 48 contiguous states and DC; Alaska and Hawaii are higher
